title: ExecutionFrictionXrayOutput
description: Structured execution friction analysis output: friction hotspots, critical path risks, ambiguities, a 7-day kill plan, and the single highest-leverage move — all grounded in transcript evidence.

executive_summary.description: 2-4 sentence overview of the execution friction posture. Covers the most critical hotspots, the friction score rationale, and the single highest-leverage move.

friction_score.description: Aggregate execution friction score. 0 = no friction, 100 = maximum friction. Based on count, severity, and blast radius of identified hotspots.

friction_hotspots.description: Specific friction points that create execution drag. Each is categorized, scored, and grounded in transcript evidence.

critical_path_risks.description: Risks that sit on the critical path and could block forward progress if not resolved.

ambiguities_to_resolve.description: Unresolved ambiguities that will create friction if left unaddressed.

next_7_day_friction_kill_plan.description: Concrete actions to reduce execution friction within the next 7 days. Each has an owner, due date, and proof artifact.

single_highest_leverage_move.description: The one action that would most reduce execution friction if completed. Designed for an executive who can only do one thing.

citations.description: Verbatim quotes from the transcript that ground the analysis.

metadata.description: Analysis metadata: which input mode was used and when the output was generated.

id.description: Unique identifier for this hotspot. Format: FH-001, FH-002, etc.

category.description: Friction category. Determines the type of execution drag this hotspot creates.

title.description: Concise, specific title. Avoid generic labels — tie to concrete meeting content.

why_it_creates_drag.description: Explanation of the causal mechanism: what specifically slows execution and why.

severity.description: Impact magnitude if this friction point is not resolved. 1 = minor inconvenience, 5 = blocks critical path.

likelihood.description: Probability that this friction point will materialize or persist. 1 = very unlikely, 5 = near certain.

blast_radius.description: Scope of impact. 'local' = single team. 'cross_team' = multiple teams. 'org_wide' = organization-level impact.

early_warning_signals.description: Observable signals that this friction point is materializing. Specific enough to monitor.

evidence.description: Transcript evidence supporting this friction hotspot. At least one verbatim quote required.

recommended_fix.description: Specific, actionable fix. Not a restatement of the problem — a concrete step to reduce friction.

owner_recommendation.description: Who should own resolving this friction point, based on transcript context.

target_resolution_window.description: Recommended timeframe to resolve. Examples: '48 hours', 'this sprint', 'before Q4 launch'.

approximate_location.description: Where in the transcript this appears. Examples: 'early in discussion', 'during infrastructure review', 'closing remarks'.

risk.description: What the critical path risk is.

blocking_dependency.description: What this risk depends on or is blocked by.

owner.description: Person or team responsible for unblocking.

due_or_trigger.description: When this must be resolved, or what event triggers it.

unblock_action.description: Specific action to unblock the dependency.

why_it_matters.description: What breaks or slows down if this ambiguity persists.

proposed_clarifying_question.description: A specific question that, if answered, would resolve the ambiguity.

action.description: Specific, executable task to reduce friction.

owner.description: Person responsible for completing this action.

due.description: When this action must be completed. Should be within 7 days.

proof_artifact.description: Tangible output that proves the action is complete.

move.description: The single most impactful action to reduce execution friction.

why.description: Why this move has the highest leverage — what it unblocks or accelerates.

deadline.description: By when this must be done to capture the leverage.

success_signal.description: Observable signal that the move succeeded.

approximate_location.description: Where in the transcript this appears.

mode_used.description: Which input mode was detected. transcript_only if no optional context fields were provided; transcript_plus_context otherwise.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this analysis was generated.
